statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Positive Nasdaq futures and expiration-day event risk keep Stress extreme, while persistent mean-reversion failure is not yet verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold. The main conditional risk window is 13:00-14:30 UTC.
headline: Nasdaq futures firm ahead of U.S. data and expiration; Tail remains WATCH
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.56% in early U.S. morning futures trading while oil retreated. Fresh continuous-NQ evidence of repeated failed retracements remains incomplete, so event and expiration risk lifts Stress more than Tail.

forecast.analysis: State Employment and the U.S. LEI arrive at 14:00 UTC. Extreme Stress persists, while Tail remains upper WATCH unless price discovery becomes one-way with shallow or failed pullbacks.
After the main releases, Tail would ease if retracements become meaningful and cross-asset pressure stabilizes; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would keep the hour near upper WATCH.
A two-way post-event market would reduce Tail toward lower WATCH. Persistent directional follow-through without meaningful retracement would be the main condition preventing that normalization.
Absent renewed one-way extension, mid-session rotation would favor lower WATCH. A fresh break that holds near an extreme with failed retracements would be the relevant adverse path.
Expiration flows can keep Stress high even if Tail remains near lower WATCH. The key distinction is whether bursts retrace or instead compound into persistent directional efficiency.
Late-session positioning can reintroduce whipsaw and directional bursts. Tail rises only modestly unless those bursts become persistent and repeatedly reject meaningful retracements.
The final cash-market hour carries elevated expiration and closing-imbalance risk. A sustained auction-driven move with little retracement would be the condition for a stronger Tail state.
After the U.S. cash close and CME equity-futures close, live path risk falls sharply. Weekend headline risk remains, but no future directional market path is assumed.
With equity futures closed, Tail stays low because no continuous price path is forming; Stress reflects only the possibility of weekend information that could affect the next reopening.
Closed-market conditions keep Tail low. Any geopolitical or policy development would be assessed only when verified and would not imply a price-path reaction before trading resumes.
No live NQ structure is expected during the weekend closure. Tail remains low while Stress captures unresolved macro and geopolitical uncertainty rather than observed market persistence.
The absence of live futures trading limits evidence for a pathological price path. Only verified weekend developments could alter the risk backdrop before the next market reopening.
Tail remains low in the closed session because directional efficiency cannot be observed. Stress remains moderate-to-elevated from potential headline gaps rather than current price action.
Closed-market conditions continue. Future risk would depend on verified new information and the eventual reopening response, not on an assumed overnight trend.
Without live NQ trading, no trend or retracement structure is inferred. Tail remains low and any change would require new verified evidence before the reopening.
Weekend headline exposure keeps Stress above a quiet-session baseline, while Tail remains low because no continuous futures price path is available to establish mean-reversion failure.
The market remains closed, so Tail is not raised by hypothetical future reactions. Verified geopolitical or policy developments would be treated as context for the later reopening.
As the weekend progresses, headline-gap uncertainty can lift Stress modestly, but Tail stays low until an actual reopening path can be observed and tested for retracements.
No live price structure is assumed. A later reopening gap alone would primarily affect Stress; Tail would require persistence after trading resumes.
Tail remains low through the closed period. The next meaningful assessment would depend on verified weekend news and, later, whether the reopening develops persistent one-way structure.
